description: This PHP script retrieves configuration templates or interface information related to the request manager system in the TestLink project. It initializes the page, determines the type of request, interacts with the tlReqMgrSystem class, and outputs the configuration data in JSON format.

classes.name: tlReqMgrSystem
classes.description: A class responsible for managing request system configurations, including retrieving types and implementation details.

methods.name: getTypes
methods.description: Returns an array of available request system types.

methods.name: getImplementationForType
methods.description: Returns the implementation name for a given request system type.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Static method returning configuration template as a string.
